**1. Who is the “friend” and what the third‑person framing does**

The “friend” is **Sameer himself**.

- In the DM (11:52 pm) Sameer describes the friend as someone who “ran his own setup for years” and is “looking to move this month itself” into “operations or general management” at “15‑18 LPA”.  
- In the college group (9:14 pm) Sameer posts a reel of a Dubai rooftop pool and writes “expanding soon boys, watch this space 😎”, to which Tushar replies “bhai owns half of Gurgaon now”. That is a persona of a booming businessman.  
- The DM immediately follows the group bragging, and Sameer adds: “yaar don’t bring this up in the group, he’s private about it.” The only person who needs to hide a job search from that specific group is the same person performing the “business is booming” act in it. The “friend” attributes match a failed/closed own‑setup owner (Sameer) who now needs salaried work but cannot admit it to his college peers.

The third‑person costume lets Sameer **preserve the successful image** he built in the group while privately securing a safety net. By casting himself as a discreet referrer for a “solid guy” he avoids ever saying “I am unemployed / I need a job”.
